property.name: The Old Mill
property.tagline: Rooms, workshops and storage to let in Kineton. Kineton businesses from £250 a month, everything included.
property.description:
The Old Mill in Kineton has rooms, workshops and storage to let. The four Mill Rooms, Unit 2 and the small rooms 5A and 5B come with everything included in one monthly price: internet, electricity, water and the service charge. They suit any small business, from treatment rooms and craft studios to desk work. The workshop and warehouse units suit businesses that need more room.

Viewings are by appointment. If nothing suits you today, join the waitlist and we will message you as soon as a space comes free.
features: Kineton businesses from £250 a month, everything included, for any kind of small business
Workshop and warehouse units with roller and double door access
Shared entrance hall with a small kitchen and toilets
Viewings by appointment: WhatsApp Pete on 07456 338 728
Tenant portal with invoices, Wi-Fi details and site updates
